scoring_justification: The CASINO2 simulation is too heavy to re-run in the verifier; we compare reported energy absorption percentages to paper's gold with tolerance and verify MPP consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold energy absorption percentages for beam voltages 62-200 kV
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I for 62-180 kV; 200 kV extrapolation consistent with trend and used in reference solution
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken directly from paper's reported values; 200 kV derived from monotonic decrease and referenced in reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values originate from the paper's published Table I and a reasonable extrapolation for completeness as used in the reference oracle

outputs.description: Percentage of total incident beam energy absorbed in the active region (0–580 nm depth) for each beam accelerating voltage.
Simulated maximum power produced (nW) derived from the energy absorption percentages and the experimental MPP baseline at 62 kV.

output_contract.notes: The output values must be traceable to the CASINO2 Monte Carlo simulations. The checker will compare the submitted percentages and simulated MPP values against independently known reference values with appropriate tolerances, and will also verify that the simulated MPP trend is monotonically decreasing (except possibly a slight increase at high voltages).
